probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently amended) A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles; a thermally conductive binder; and a solvent, __wherein the thermally conductive binder comprises a premixed solder paste__.

2. (Currently amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to an electronic component surface __and forms boiling nucleation sites on the surface__.

3. (Currently amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed during application to the electronic component surface __and the thermally conductive binder is subsequently melted to affix the cavity-generating particles__.

9. (Currently amended) A composition comprising cavity generating particles, a binder, and a carrier wherein the particle to binder ratio being about 1 gram to 0.5-0.8 grams and the carrier being about 10 ml per gram of particles, __wherein the binder is a thermally conductive premixed solder paste__.

10. (Currently amended) The composition of claim 9, wherein the carrier is selected from the group comprising ethyl alcohol, isopropyl alcohol, acetone, methylethyl ketone, FC-72, or FC-87, __and the cavity-generating particles are affixed to a surface by melting the binder__.

11. (Currently amended) The composition of claim 9, wherein the binder is premixed solder paste __having thermal conductivity greater than epoxy adhesives__.

12. (Original) The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity generating particles are selected from the group comprising nickel, copper, aluminum, silver, iron, brass and alloys.

13. (Original) The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity generating particles are 8-12 pm in size.

14. (Original) The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity generating particles are 30-50 pm in size.

15. (Currently amended) The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity generating particles are 100-200 pm in size __and are selected to generate boiling nucleation sites when the composition is applied to an electronic component surface__.

16. (Currently amended) A composition of matter comprising carrier, binder, and cavity generating particles, wherein said composition of matter contains, in relative proportion: about 10 ml carrier; about 0.5 to 0.8 grams binder; and about 1 gram of cavity generating particles, __wherein the binder is a thermally conductive premixed solder paste__.

17. (Currently amended) The composition of claim 16, wherein the carrier is selected from the group comprising ethyl alcohol, isopropyl alcohol, acetone, methylethyl ketone, FC-72, or FC-87, __and the cavity-generating particles are affixed to a surface by melting the binder__.

18. (Currently amended) The composition of claim 16, wherein the binder is premixed solder paste __having thermal conductivity greater than epoxy adhesives__.

19. (Original) The composition of claim 16, wherein the cavity generating particles are selected from the group comprising nickel, copper, aluminum, silver, iron, brass and alloys.

20. (Original) The composition of claim 16, wherein the cavity generating particles are 8-12 pm in size.

21. (Original) The composition of claim 16, wherein the cavity generating particles are 30-50 pm in size.

22. (Currently amended) The composition of claim 16, wherein the cavity generating particles are 100-200 pm in size __and are selected to generate boiling nucleation sites when the composition is applied to an electronic component surface__.
